# Truthprenuer

> Truthprenuer helps people validate startup ideas using real human feedback and AI-powered analysis, understand relevant patterns and risks, and connect with people who can help them build.

Truthprenuer is an empirical startup validation engine combining structured human feedback with AI-powered pattern synthesis, startup health signals, and founder-validator networking.

## Core Capabilities
- Human Validation: Structured feedback from experienced founders, operators, and industry domain experts.
- AI Validation: Synthetic customer persona testing, market risk analysis, competitive differentiation stress-testing, and assumption validation.
- Startup Health & Conviction Signals: Real-time conviction metrics based on customer validation data, pricing willingness, and market pull.
- Founder & Validator Networking: Connecting early-stage builders with mentors, angel investors, and co-founders.

- [Startup Validation](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/startup-validation): How to validate startup ideas before building.
- [AI Startup Validation](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/ai-startup-validation): Leveraging AI for rapid market hypothesis testing and customer persona simulation.
- [Human Validation](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/human-validation): Gathering high-signal feedback from real domain practitioners.
- [Startup Analysis](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/startup-analysis): Deconstructing problem-solution fit and unit economics.
- [Startup Health](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/startup-health): Quantifying market signals, customer conviction, and viability metrics.
- [How It Works](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/how-it-works): The step-by-step validation lifecycle on Truthprenuer.
- [Leaderboard](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/top-validators): Top community validators ranked by feedback accuracy and conviction score.
- [Explore Validations](https://truthprenuer.pages.dev/explore): Browse active validation sprints across SaaS, AI, FinTech, and B2B.
